Load data
```{r}
#########
## SBS ##
#########

## Mutation count
input_file <- "/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/spp_wgs_uc.txt"
input_catalog <- ICAMS::ReadCatalog(file = input_file)

mut_counts <- input_catalog %>% colSums() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 'colnames<-' ("mutCount") %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  mutate(logmutCount = log10(mutCount / 1000 + 1))

## Assignment result
sbs_res <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/spe/wgs_uc/SBS96/Suggested_Solution/COSMIC_SBS96_Decomposed_Solution/Activities/COSMIC_SBS96_Activities.txt") %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Samples") %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(.x < 0.05, 0, .x))) %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  gather(data = ., key = "signatures", value = "value", -Samples) %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(grepl(pattern = "_", x = Samples) ~ "ON",
                          grepl(pattern = "T", x = Samples) ~ "T",
                          grepl(pattern = "N", x = Samples) ~ "AN"),
         group = paste0("UC", as.numeric(str_extract(Samples, "\\d+"))),
         newName = paste0(group, type)) %>% 
  left_join(x = ., y = mut_counts, by = "Samples")
```

co-occurence analysis with fishers test
```{r}
## Combine SBS DBS and ID 
combined_res <- sbs_res %>% dplyr::select(names(dbs_res)) %>%
  rbind(., dbs_res, id_res) %>%
  mutate(status = ifelse(value > 0.05, 1, 0)) ## presence (>5%) or absence

## List of all cosmic signatures in combined_res
cosmic_sig <- as.character(unique(combined_res$signatures))

## Pairwise comparison between COSMIC signatures
co_res <- list() ## co occurrence results
for(i in cosmic_sig) {
  print(i)
  for(j in cosmic_sig) {
    print(j)
    if(j == i) { ## If i and j are the same signature. skip.
      next
    } else {
      contig_tbl <- combined_res %>% dplyr::filter(signatures %in% c(i, j)) %>%
        dplyr::select(newName, signatures, status) %>%
        spread(data = ., key = signatures, value = status) %>%
        mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
        'colnames<-' (c("Samples", "Sig1", "Sig2"))
      
      contig_tbl <- table(factor(contig_tbl$Sig1, levels = c(0, 1)),
                          factor(contig_tbl$Sig2, levels = c(0, 1)))
    
      co.test <- fisher.test(contig_tbl) ## co occurrence
      
      # Haldane-Anscombe correction in case zero cell count
      corrected_or <- ((contig_tbl[2,2]+0.5) * (contig_tbl[1,1]+0.5)) / ((contig_tbl[2,1]+0.5) * (contig_tbl[1,2]+0.5))
    
      co_res[[paste0(i,"_",j)]] <- data.frame(Sig1 = i,
                                              Sig2 = j,
                                              Sig1only = contig_tbl[2,1],
                                              Sig2only = contig_tbl[1,2],
                                              Neither = contig_tbl[1,1],
                                              Both = contig_tbl[2,2],
                                              pval = co.test$p.value,
                                              or = co.test$estimate,
                                              halane_anscombe_correction_or = log2(corrected_or))
    }
  }
}

co_res <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, co_res))
co_res$padj <- p.adjust(co_res$pval, method = "BH") ## FDR

## Process data for plotting
co_res_pd <- co_res %>% dplyr::select(Sig1, Sig2, halane_anscombe_correction_or) %>%
  spread(data = ., key = "Sig2", value = "halane_anscombe_correction_or") %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sig1") %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(., 0)))

hc <- hclust(dist(co_res_pd), method = "average")
order_sig <- hc$labels[hc$order]
order_sig <- order_sig[c(1:4,6,5,7:16)]

## Using OLO optimal leaf ordering 
library(seriation)
library(dendsort)
d <- dist(co_res_pd)
ord <- seriate(d, method = "OLO")  # optimal leaf ordering
order_sig <- get_order(ord) %>% names()

## Factor order based on OLO
co_res$Sig1 <- factor(co_res$Sig1, levels = order_sig)
co_res$Sig2 <- factor(co_res$Sig2, levels = order_sig)

max_abs <- round(max(abs(co_res$halane_anscombe_correction_or), na.rm = TRUE))

p12 <- ggplot(co_res, aes(x = Sig1, y = Sig2, fill = halane_anscombe_correction_or)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "dodgerblue", mid = "white", high = "firebrick3",
                       midpoint = 0,
                       limits = c(-max_abs, max_abs),
                       name = expression(log[2](OR))) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "p-value", range = c(3, 1)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 4.5, xend = 4.5, y = 0.5, yend = 4.5), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0.5, xend = 4.5, y = 4.5, yend = 4.5), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 5.5, xend = 12.5, y = 12.5, yend = 12.5), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 5.5, xend = 12.5, y = 5.5, yend = 5.5), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 12.5, xend = 12.5, y = 5.5, yend = 12.5), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 5.5, xend = 5.5, y = 5.5, yend = 12.5), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.2) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(3, "pt"),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
        legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA))
```
